description: This file defines a class for calculating trigonometric cosecant and hyperbolic cosecant functions, including support for array inputs. It belongs to the PhpSpreadsheet project's calculation library, specifically the MathTrig functions for trigonometry.

classes.name: Cosecant
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute the cosecant and hyperbolic cosecant of a given angle, supporting both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: csc
methods.description: Calculates the cosecant of an angle, supports array or float input.

methods.name: csch
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosecant of an angle, supports array or float input.
